about: L6-WP02 characterization suites for lane L6 (Connections and Marketplace), planset v060 L6 section 4. Each suite pins a guarantee at citrate-core a826e441 before an L6 work package changes the code around it. A later L6 PR that changes a pinned behavior names the suite and test it supersedes and replaces the assertion only with a stricter one, in a commit that says why. LQ runs every suite here on every merge-queue group; char_suite_is_listed_for_lq fails when this file, docs/MCP_MARKETPLACE.md and the suite files stop naming the same tests.

suites.pins: connections: no command returns a token and no serialized status names or carries one (before connect, after the exchange, all connected, after disconnect, vault locked); with no client credentials connect is NotConfigured before the callback port is bound or a browser opened; a drive-by or forged callback never burns the sign-in and a callback without code fails closed; vault slots are connection-<service> and backend-reserved; an absent, locked, expired or empty token is never handed out; the lane registry, the doc and the suite files name the same tests

user-added MCP servers: a saved server is disabled and needs a successful probe of the entry as it stands before it is enabled; a probe report claiming a trusted tool is refused; env values live in the keychain and never in a file; at most 16 servers; Hermes is offered the node server's read tools only (HERMES_NODE_WRITE_TOOLS false, the rendered node entry has allow_write_tools false)

Store: the production catalog key slot is empty and an empty slot refuses (no_key) before any fetch or write, for the view and for stage; a catalog with a third-party listing is refused even with a good signature, the view shows nothing and keeps no copy, and nothing can be staged from it

notes: char_hermes_node_write_tools_off reads hermes_mcp (L1) through its public API only; turning node write tools on is owner-gated (09 section 10 item 2) and supersedes that one test in an L1 PR. char_store_no_key_refuses_before_network supersedes on the catalog key ceremony (09 section 10 item 1).
